pairs.subject: the den of lions at dawn
pairs.question: Do the left and right images show the same place (the den of lions at dawn)?
pairs.left: Daniel standing calm and upright in the centre of the den, arms relaxed at his sides.; Lions couched on the sand at Daniel's feet and sides; Darius in purple court robe with cream tunic, gold collar and blue sash, leaning at the rim; a faint angelic glow near the top of the den.
pairs.right: Daniel, unhurt, rising up out of the den with attendants' hands on his arms; Darius in royal court robes with signet ring at the rim; attendants in period linen and armor pulling the rope; a few lions low in the shadowed pit, calm and not attacking

pairs.subject: Daniel
pairs.question: Is Daniel the same person in the left and right images?
pairs.left: Daniel, unhurt, rising up out of the den with attendants' hands on his arms; Darius in royal court robes with signet ring at the rim; attendants in period linen and armor pulling the rope; a few lions low in the shadowed pit, calm and not attacking
pairs.right: Daniel standing tall before the king, one hand lifted in refusal; Belshazzar seated on a throne in a deep crimson fringed robe over a white tunic, gold-banded crown; courtiers in jeweled garments at the edges; gold vessels on the tables
